Databricks & PySpark Bootcamp 2026 — Beginner to Advanced

Welcome to the complete Databricks + PySpark Bootcamp, designed for Data Engineers who want to build strong PySpark fundamentals and progress toward advanced Databricks, real-world projects, production deployment, and troubleshooting.

This bootcamp is divided into **3 major sections:

SECTION 1 — PYSPARK FUNDAMENTALS

We will start from the basics and build a strong foundation in:

✅ Data Engineering & Spark Fundamentals
✅ PySpark Architecture
✅ SparkSession & DataFrames
✅ Reading & Writing CSV, JSON & Parquet
✅ Schemas & Data Types
✅ Transformations & Actions
✅ Joins
✅ Aggregations
✅ String & Date Functions
✅ Window Functions
✅ Arrays, Structs & Nested JSON

SECTION 2 — ADVANCED PYSPARK & DATABRICKS

We will move into advanced concepts including:

✅ Advanced PySpark
✅ Spark Architecture
✅ Driver, Executors, Jobs, Stages & Tasks
✅ Partitions & Shuffle
✅ Lazy Evaluation & DAG
✅ Spark Performance Optimization
✅ Broadcast Joins
✅ Repartition vs Coalesce
✅ Data Skew & Salting
✅ Adaptive Query Execution
✅ Spark UI & Performance Troubleshooting
✅ Databricks Platform
✅ Azure ADLS Gen2 Integration
✅ Delta Lake
✅ Unity Catalog & Data Governance

SECTION 3 — REAL-WORLD PROJECTS + STREAMING + TROUBLESHOOTING

The final section focuses on production-oriented Data Engineering.

We will cover:

🔥 Batch Data Engineering
🔥 Medallion Architecture — Bronze → Silver → Gold
